reason: The first protocol-v2 session completed successfully and emitted one structured scientific answer, but the supervisor passed a relative --output-last-message path after changing the child working directory to the isolated clone. Codex therefore retained the exact answer in its JSONL event stream but could not create the convenience output file.
change: Resolve the supervisor output directory before entering the isolated clone; deterministically recover the last completed agent_message from the retained JSONL stream when the convenience file is absent; and enforce the already registered 50000-token session limit from the terminal Codex usage event. The fallback validates that the message is a JSON object and records its exact event line. No model retry is permitted or performed.
